methods.delta_restriction: Use identical C family items for EC and ER within each seed where BOTH endpoint statuses are match/mismatch. Report pooled pairs and equal-seed mean; also a fixed family subset parseable in all six EC/ER checkpoints. Selection depends on outputs.
methods.gap: unchanged strict accuracy minus trained strict accuracy = excess rescued format/unit errors + excess literal mismatches + excess unscored strict errors (trained minus unchanged). This is accounting, not causal attribution.
methods.length: Post hoc fixed bins and short <=48 tokens. Nonfinal lines exclude blank lines and lines containing FINAL. Equals counts are descriptive layout proxies, not counts of valid reasoning steps.
methods.nonnested: Strict success need not be numeric success: endpoint suffix grammar is narrower. Numeric gap + excess rescue + base-minus-trained strict-only success = strict gap.
methods.partition: strict correct; else numeric match; else numeric mismatch; else unscored. All denominators include every generated row.
methods.pooling: Arms pool 3 fixed checkpoints, 300 observations per form over the same 100 families. Unchanged has 100/form and is not 3 independent baselines. No independence-based inference.
methods.privacy: No gold answers or complete raw responses saved. Numeric literals in final-answer patterns are replaced by [NUM]; whitespace is collapsed, unit wording/case retained. At most 3 anonymised response-prefix excerpts: take first 200 source characters, mask numbers/item IDs/title-case words, collapse whitespace, then cap at 200 characters. Pattern counts combine scalar variants.
methods.uncertainty: Counts and percentages only; no resampling or significance tests.
